claim: E3M1's open streets carry almost no props: of the sprites standing in its sky-ceilinged sectors only five are visible plain decoration (a circus poster, a bonfire, a smoke column, flattened gore, a key emblem) and one a breakable tapestry (type 417); the rest are foes, pickups, wall cracks, markers, 159 exploders and 45 invisible sound sprites.
evidence: E3M1 sprites 96 (tile 981 poster), 329 (3566 bonfire), 331 (754 smoke), 369 (2954 gore), 413 (2542 key emblem), all type 0; sprite 721 (type 417, tile 614): work/consolidation probe of visible sprites in parallax-ceiling sectors, 2026-11-26
use: A Blood town street is dressed by its facades and light, not by props; a few telling things (a poster, a fire, a sign of a key) are enough.
